item.title: McAuley: Naomh Éanna have a major point to prove
item.description: NAOMH Éanna defender James McAuley has issued a rallying cry to his teammates ahead of the resumption of club action and has urged them to put a disappointing 2019 campaign behind them.

item.title: Star learn Conference fate as four new teams join Division One
item.description: THE Men’s National Competitions Committee (MNCC) has confirmed which teams will compete in each of the Men’s Super League and Division One Conferences, with four new sides also joining Division One next season.

item.title: Business Focus: McCabe Bathrooms offer expert quality at competitive price
item.description: When it comes to bathroom fitting and renovations, expert design and quality is essential. And at McCabe Bathrooms it;s guaranteed at incredibly competitive prices.

item.title: Put Big Jack’s statue outside Aviva say local fans
item.description: THE West Belfast Ireland Supporter’s Club is calling for a statue to be erected of Jack Charlton at the Aviva Stadium in Dublin. The 85 year-old, who passed away on Friday took charge of the Republic of Ireland national football team in February 1986, leading them to two successful European Championship qualifications and their first […]

item.title: Cultúrlann comes storming back from lockdown with virtual harvest of August events
item.description: Irish language arts centre, Cultúrlann McAdam Ó Fiaich is roaring back into action from a three-month lockdown with an exciting series of events.

item.title: ‘A sad day for Irish football’ as tributes pour in for Big Jack
item.description: TRIBUTES poured in following the passing of Jack Charlton on Saturday.

item.title: Pump it up! Shaftesbury Rec Centre reopens doors 'slowly and safely'
item.description: The treadmills are resounding to the thump of running feet once more at Shaftesbury Recreation Centre as the four-month lockdown comes to an end.

item.title: Tennyson happy to be on the light path
item.description: JAMES Tennyson believes his move up to lightweight has brought the best out of him and feels his power will be a decisive factor when he faces Gavin Gwynne for the British title at Matchroom Boxing HQ in Essex on August 1.

item.title: EXCLUSIVE: Meet the CEO of the Poleglass stock market-listed company in the frontlines of the search for a cure for Covid
item.description: It's a publicly-listed company, just one of four across the North whose shares are traded on the stock market, its bioscientists are carrying out cutting-edge research in the search for a cure for Covid-19 and it's based on our doorstep.

item.title: VIDEO FOCUS: Heatwave is Turning up the heat on a new wave of beauty
item.description: OPENED six years ago on the Oldpark Road, Heatwave tanning salon has established itself as one of the most popular and best of its kind in the city.
